draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.23, the 78th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 18 at RB. He went 84th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Leon Washington. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile), 10-yard split (88th percentile). College production: 1,102 rushing yards in 2022, 10th of 18 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Miami Dolphins (reserve). 44 career games and 36 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (14 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: yards after contact per carry 3.0 (97th percentile), yards per carry 5.7 (97th percentile), scrimmage yards 1,838 (97th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 running back who played: 1,838 scrimmage yards against a median of 530, above the norm.
